content.rationale: Extensibility is where the table meets verb independence; the gate forces the one-row contract to answer to both without demanding a second verb as proof. Its two edges span two cells — one prose parent (natural→natural) and one requirement-sentence parent (structured→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
